metadata.Name: Russian Financial Statements Database
metadata.Description: The Russian Financial Statements Database is an open, harmonized collection of annual unconsolidated financial statements of Russian firms in 2011-2023.
Provider: The Institute for the Rule of Law
Derived From: Uniform State Register of Legal Entities
Federal State Statistics Service of Russia
metadata.Paper Title: Russian Financial Statements Database: A firm-level collection of the universe of financial statements
metadata.Abstract: The Russian Financial Statements Database is an open, harmonized collection of annual unconsolidated financial statements of the universe of Russian firms in 2011-2023. It features multiple end-user quality-of-life improvements such as data imputation, statement articulation, harmonization across data providers and formats, and data enrichment.
